# Tech Genz — Software & Technology Team

> Ideas Engineered Beyond Limits.

Tech Genz is a software and technology team building high-performance web applications, cloud systems, and interactive digital experiences. Formed around innovation, engineering discipline, and collaborative craft, the team operates as a student developer team associated with the student community of N.B.K.R. Institute of Science & Technology (NBKRIST), located in Vidyanagar, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Identity & Disambiguation
- Primary Brand Name: Tech Genz
- Alternate Name: TechGenz
- Role: Software & Technology Team
- Primary Website: https://techgenz.site/
- Primary GitHub Organization: https://github.com/Tech-Genz
- Primary GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Tech-Genz/techgenz
- Student Community Association: N.B.K.R. Institute of Science & Technology (NBKRIST)
- Location: Vidyanagar, Andhra Pradesh, India
- College Portal: https://nbkrist.org/
- Note: Tech Genz is formed by members of the student community; it operates independently as a collaborative student developer team.

## Motive
To use technology to solve real-world problems, encourage innovation, develop technical skills, and transform ideas into meaningful digital experiences.

## Vision
To build a smarter digital future through collaboration, continuous learning, and creative software development.

## Motto
"Ideas Engineered Beyond Limits."
